In this video, I take you on a complete 2-day, 2-night solo trip to discover the hidden beauty of Ghatshila, Jharkhand, all while keeping the costs low.
Discover the best ways to reach this scenic gem, including an in-depth look at the Howrah to Ghatshila train journey (Steel Express and more options), and my personal tips on how to save an entire half-day of sightseeing by planning your overnight travel perfectly! Learn how I managed the whole trip on a budget of just ₹2,500 per person from Kolkata.
